purpose: First-pass direct-pricing research for previously undocumented German CPO identities; fail closed where current contract-free pricing is not numerically established.

cpos.operatorScope: Public charging stations operated by FairEnergie GmbH in Reutlingen and the surrounding region

evidence.facts: Official current page states ad-hoc charging at FairEnergie stations costs 0.65 EUR/kWh with no base fee. Blocking fee is 0.10 EUR/min from minute 241, capped at 12 EUR/session, applied daily 06:00-24:00 and not charged 00:00-06:00. The same page lists FairEnergie normal and fast charging sites and explicitly says the blocking rule applies to all own charging points.
Official terms effective 2026-03-01 confirm contract-free ladeapp/web charging via QR and card, and an ad-hoc gross energy price of 0.65 EUR/kWh for both AC and DC.

cpos.guardrail: Do not substitute FairStromEmobil subscriber or roaming tariffs for the contract-free direct tariff.

cpos.operatorScope: Public charging stations presented by Stadtwerke Nürtingen GmbH

evidence.facts: Official page confirms more than 40 charging points at 16 sites, ad-hoc QR charging through Ladepay with PayPal or credit card, and separately publishes the SWN customer-card tariff. It does not expose the numeric Ladepay ad-hoc price in accessible text.

cpos.reasonDeferred: The public page confirms a distinct ad-hoc QR/Ladepay payment path but only publishes the customer-card price table. Using the subscriber 0.33/0.42 EUR/kWh figures as ad-hoc pricing would be an unsupported substitution.
cpos.neededToComplete: Resolve the current Ladepay checkout for each SWN EVSE or an official station-level/direct-payment feed exposing the exact contract-free AC/DC energy price and any time/blocking terms.
cpos.guardrail: Do not generalize the SWN customer-card tariff to ad-hoc users.

cpos.canonicalName: Stadtwerk am See GmbH & Co. KG
cpos.operatorScope: Public charging stations operated by Stadtwerk am See in the Bodensee region

evidence.facts: Official current page states charging is possible at all Stadtwerk-am-See-operated stations, supports eCharge+ and Direct Payment, and displays the MEIN AUTO STROM subscriber tariff at 0.49 EUR/kWh AC and 0.59 EUR/kWh DC with a validity label dating from 2022-12-01. The page does not expose a current numeric Direct Payment tariff.
Official operator statement documents 190 publicly usable charging points at the end of 2023 and fast charging up to 300 kW, confirming material public CPO scope.

cpos.reasonDeferred: A current contract-free Direct Payment path is explicitly available, but its numeric price is not published in accessible official text. The visible 0.49/0.59 EUR/kWh product is a subscriber product and carries an old effective-date label, so it is not promoted to the direct tariff.
cpos.neededToComplete: Resolve an eCharge+/Direct Payment station checkout or authoritative station-level feed for each SWSee EVSE, including current energy price and any time/blocking/parking components.
cpos.guardrail: Do not treat the MEIN AUTO STROM subscriber price as the current Direct Payment price and do not infer a 2026 direct tariff from the 2022 validity label.

consistencyNotes: None of the three canonical operator names appeared in the active PR #73 patch before this pass.
FairEnergie is complete because its official current direct tariff explicitly covers AC and DC own stations and the blocking rule is stated for all own charging points.
Nürtingen remains partial because the official ad-hoc path and subscriber tariff are separate and no numeric Ladepay direct price is exposed.
Stadtwerk am See remains partial because Direct Payment is confirmed but its numeric current price is not publicly exposed; the subscriber tariff is not substituted.
No eMI3 prefix was invented where no authoritative prefix mapping was established.
